what: Breathing giant words — several words stretched horizontally and vertically to fill the panel (98.5% width, 97.5% height) switch every 3 seconds. The current word flattens vertically to 0 in .6s expo.inOut and slips out 48.5% of the panel height upward (downward if the next turn is even). The next word enters flattened from the opposite 48.5%, grows 1.3% more, and settles at the center (−1.5%). It pauses when the panel is offscreen

options.fill-x: Word width relative to panel width, default .985
options.fill-y: Word height relative to panel height, default .975
options.grow: Scale by which the entered words grow further, default 1.013 (original 1.15 → 1.165)
options.shift: Distance for sliding out and in (ratio of panel height), default .485
options.rest: Line position (ratio of board height), default −.015

note: The original stretched WebGL MSDF text to the panel size. This part stretches DOM text with transform to get the same ratio and curve — to overlay it on a canvas, leave the canvas background empty and put this panel behind it

from.where: index.js giant word (glText) — original activeText watcher: scale.y → 0 · position.y .485vh · ±1, new word scale.y 1.165vh · position.y −.015vh, .6s expo.inOut, every 3s
